page.metaDescription: Apply to teach American English online with Amerivo. Set your own rate, get paid monthly.

earn.a: You set your own rate between {min} and {max} per 50-minute lesson. Amerivo keeps a {commission}% platform commission, so at {example} you receive {net} per lesson. You can also offer 5- and 10-lesson packages.

paid.q: When and how do I get paid?
paid.a: Payouts are sent monthly, by the 28th, through Stripe Connect to your bank account. Each payout covers the lessons completed in the previous period.

who.a: Amerivo teachers are U.S. native English speakers. A teaching certification (TESOL, TEFL or CELTA) or classroom experience is strongly recommended, and every applicant completes ID verification and a short interview.

equipment.a: A computer with a webcam, a headset or good microphone, a stable internet connection (10 Mbps or faster) and a quiet, well-lit space. Lessons run in the browser — no software to install.

wizard.usOnly: Only U.S. native English speakers can teach on Amerivo.

personal.photoHint: A friendly, well-lit headshot. Students see it on your profile and in search results.
personal.timeZoneHint: Used to show your availability to students in their local time.
personal.genderHint: Some students filter by a preferred teacher gender. You can change this later.

professional.net: You receive {net} after the {commission}% platform commission
professional.trialHint: Students can meet you once before booking. You can change this later.

previews.label: Coming up next
previews.identityText: Government ID, passport or driver's license, plus a selfie. Handled securely by Stripe Identity.
previews.videoText: Background · Experience · Teaching style. Students see it on your profile.

identity.intro: We verify every teacher before they can accept bookings. Upload a valid photo ID; you'll be asked for a quick selfie to match it.
identity.uploadHint: Front and back if applicable · JPG, PNG or PDF
identity.secure: Handled securely by Stripe Identity. Amerivo never stores a copy of your ID document; we only receive the verification result.
identity.taxText: We collect your W-9; 1099 forms are issued automatically. You'll complete it when you connect your payout account.

video.intro: Record a video of up to 2 minutes. Students watch it on your profile before booking, so speak naturally and look at the camera.
video.formats: MP4, MOV or WebM · max 2 minutes
